[[File:Rune scimitar detail.png|left|130px]]
The '''rune scimitar''' is a [[scimitar]] requiring level 40 [[Attack]] to wield. It can be created with 2 [[runite bar]]s at level 90 [[Smithing]], or dropped by various monsters such as [[Zamorak warrior]]s or [[Fire giant]]s. 

It is the second strongest scimitar available behind the [[Dragon scimitar]], and the strongest scimitar in [[free-to-play]]. Furthermore, it is considered the strongest [[melee weapon]] in most situations in free-to-play due to its unmatched attack and strength bonuses for its attack speed.

[[Ironmen]] may prefer to create a [[barronite mace]] or purchase a [[rune sword]] from the [[Champions' Guild]] (requiring 32 [[Quest points]]). [[Members]]-only alternatives to the rune scimitar include the [[rapier]] (after [[Cabin Fever]]), [[brine sabre]], and [[ancient staff]] (after [[Desert Treasure I]]). 

Players can attach a [[Rune scimitar ornament kit (Guthix)|Guthix]], [[Rune scimitar ornament kit (Saradomin)|Saradomin]] or [[Rune scimitar ornament kit (Zamorak)|Zamorak ornament kit]], obtained from [[Clue scroll (beginner)|beginner]] [[Treasure Trails]], to create a [[rune scimitar (guthix)|Guthix]], [[Rune scimitar (saradomin)|Saradomin]] and [[Rune scimitar (zamorak)|Zamorak rune scimitar]], respectively. This only alters its appearance, and gives no stat enhancements, though the Saradomin and Zamorak variants will provide protection from the respective factions in the [[God Wars Dungeon]]. It can be dismantled at any time, returning the scimitar and ornament kit.
